import unittest

from solution import normalize_chain


class NormalizeChainTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_preserves_leaf_to_root_order_and_extra_keys(self):
        records = [
            {"subject": "leaf", "issuer": "middle", "meta": {"depth": 0}},
            {"subject": "middle", "issuer": "root", "serial": 12},
            {"subject": "root", "issuer": "root"},
        ]
        result = normalize_chain(records)
        self.assertEqual(result, records)
        self.assertEqual([record["subject"] for record in result], ["leaf", "middle", "root"])
        self.assertEqual(normalize_chain([]), [])

    def test_outer_and_entry_types(self):
        for records in (None, (), {}):
            with self.subTest(records=records), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                normalize_chain(records)
        for entry in (None, [], "record"):
            with self.subTest(entry=entry), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                normalize_chain([entry])

    def test_missing_and_malformed_required_fields(self):
        cases = [
            [{}],
            [{"subject": "s"}],
            [{"issuer": "i"}],
            [{"subject": "", "issuer": "i"}],
            [{"subject": "s", "issuer": ""}],
            [{"subject": 1, "issuer": "i"}],
            [{"subject": "s", "issuer": None}],
        ]
        for records in cases:
            with self.subTest(records=records), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                normalize_chain(records)

    def test_every_record_and_nested_value_is_deeply_copied(self):
        shared = {"items": [[]]}
        records = [
            {"subject": "leaf", "issuer": "root", "extra": shared},
            {"subject": "root", "issuer": "root", "extra": shared},
        ]
        result = normalize_chain(records)
        self.assertIsNot(result, records)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], records[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1], records[1])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["extra"], shared)
        self.assertIsNot(result[1]["extra"], shared)
        result[0]["extra"]["items"][0].append(1)
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["extra"], {"items": [[]]})
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["extra"], {"items": [[]]})
        records[0]["extra"]["items"][0].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["extra"]["items"][0], [1])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
